Flow.description: Notifies Dust Admins when a new AI Agent request is submitted and notifies the requester when the request is approved or rejected.
Flow.label: AI Agent - Request Notifications

textTemplates.name: AgentModificationRequest
textTemplates.text:
AI AGENT GOVERNANCE
Agent Modification Request
Hello,

A modification request has been submitted for an existing AI Agent and is ready for review.
Agent {!$Record.AgentName__c}
Category {!$Record.UseCaseCategory__c}
Request Type Agent Modification
REQUESTED CHANGE
{!$Record.AIAgentRequestedChange__c}
Data & Connectors {!$Record.Connectors__c}
Usage Mode {!$Record.UsageMode__c}
Review focus

Review the requested change and assess whether it impacts the agent's data access, connectors, actions, execution mode, sharing scope or overall risk level.

Contact the requester if additional information or a short review discussion is required.
Review Modification Request
Dust Admin Team
Carmignac AI Agent Governance

textTemplates.name: ApprovedAgent
textTemplates.text:
AI AGENT GOVERNANCE
Agent Request Approved
Hello,

Your request to create the {!$Record.AgentName__c} AI Agent has been approved.

You can now start building your agent in Dust.
Agent {!$Record.AgentName__c}
Category {!$Record.UseCaseCategory__c}
Purpose {!$Record.AgentPurpose__c}
What happens next?

The Dust Admin team will support you during the build to help ensure:
  • the right data sources and access levels are used;
  • connectors and actions are appropriate for the use case;
  • execution time and credit consumption are optimised;
  • the output is adapted to the user need;
  • the appropriate sharing scope is defined.
Important: this approval allows you to start building the agent. Its final configuration and sharing scope should be reviewed before making it available to a wider audience.
Open Agent Request
Need help? Contact dust@carmignac.com.

Dust Admin Team
Carmignac AI Agent Governance

textTemplates.name: ApprovedAgentModification
textTemplates.text:
AI AGENT GOVERNANCE
Agent Modification Approved
Hello,

Your request to modify the {!$Record.AgentName__c} AI Agent has been approved.

You can now proceed with the requested change.
Agent {!$Record.AgentName__c}
Category {!$Record.UseCaseCategory__c}
APPROVED CHANGE
{!$Record.AIAgentRequestedChange__c}
What happens next?

You can implement the approved modification. The Dust Admin team can support you where needed to help ensure that:
  • data sources and access levels remain appropriate;
  • connectors and actions remain aligned with the approved use case;
  • execution time and credit consumption remain efficient;
  • the output remains relevant for users;
  • the sharing scope remains appropriate.
Important: if the implemented change materially affects the agent's data access, connectors, actions, execution mode or sharing scope, the agent's governance information should be updated accordingly.
Open Modification Request
Need help? Contact dust@carmignac.com.

Dust Admin Team
Carmignac AI Agent Governance

textTemplates.name: NotApprovedAgent
textTemplates.text:
AI AGENT GOVERNANCE
Agent Request Not Approved
Hello,

Following the review of your request to create the {!$Record.AgentName__c} AI Agent, we are not able to approve the request in its current form.
Agent {!$Record.AgentName__c}
Category {!$Record.UseCaseCategory__c}
Purpose {!$Record.AgentPurpose__c}
Next step

If the reasons for this decision have not already been shared with you, the Dust Admin team will contact you shortly to explain them and discuss the next steps.

This does not necessarily mean that the use case cannot be addressed. We can help you adjust the scope, approach or configuration where appropriate.
Open Agent Request
If needed, contact dust@carmignac.com.

Dust Admin Team
Carmignac AI Agent Governance
